style: Simplified, chunky stylized fantasy game UI art: a few big readable shapes, thick dark-brown outlines, flat color masses with two-step cel shading and one soft highlight, very little texture. No filigree, no tiny rivets, no engraved patterns, no gem encrustations, no pedestals or stands. Saturated but harmonious colors. Do not imitate any existing game, franchise or official artwork. Include no text, letters or numerals. This is a navigation button icon for a SHARED WORLD UI that every playable hero uses, so it must never hint at any hero: no dragon scales, claws, wings or dragon fire, and no people. The world is an original realm of enchanted forest ruins with moss-covered pale stone, tarnished bronze, warm parchment and teal rune light.
